request.style: English, female solo voice with choir, piano, strings, harp, organ, solemn and hopeful, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
The hour has come for the Son of Man to be glorified
A grain of wheat falls into the earth and dies
It remains alone if it does not break
But if it dies, it bears much fruit in the end

[Pre-Chorus]
Whoever loves his life loses it in this world
Whoever hates his life keeps it for eternal life

[Chorus]
If anyone serves me, he must follow me
Where I am, there my servant will be also
The Father will honor him who serves me here

[Verse]
My soul is troubled now, what shall I say
Father, save me from this hour of pain
No, for this purpose I came to this hour

[Chorus]
If anyone serves me, he must follow me
Where I am, there my servant will be also
The Father will honor him who serves me here

[Bridge]
Father, glorify your name in this moment
A voice came from heaven, I have glorified it
And I will glorify it again, said the voice

[Outro]
Where I am, there my servant will be
